payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the methods used to extract textual patterns for error generation, including the types of patterns and their applications.

claims.text: Textual patterns are extracted from an annotated corpus, identifying short transformation patterns in the form of (incorrect phrase, correct phrase).
Patterns are learned for generating all types of errors, using word forms and part-of-speech tags for matching.
A total of 35,625 patterns were generated from the training data, which are used to insert errors into grammatically correct sentences.
